# "3x the filament cost" isn't a price. It's a guess.

> Free calculator for makers selling 3D-printed parts: price one print from filament, electricity, printer depreciation, failed-print rate, and post-processing labor, then check whether your marketplace fee and target margin actually clear at the price you're charging.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
